What departments does Bharati Vidyapeeth: Bharati Vidyapeeth offers engineering programs in the following departments: Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics & Telecommunication, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, and Artificial Intelligence & Data Science.
What is the admission process?: Admissions to Bharati Vidyapeeth are conducted through the Maharashtra State CET (MHT-CET) or JEE Main scores. Students must register on the DTE Maharashtra portal and participate in the centralized admission process (CAP). Direct admission (management quota) is also available.
What are the college timings?: The college operates Monday to Saturday from 7:30 AM to 5:00 PM. Administrative offices are open from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
Where is Bharati Vidyapeeth located?: Bharati Vidyapeeth is located at Bharati Vidyapeeth Educational Complex, Pune / Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.
What facilities does Bharati Vidyapeeth: Bharati Vidyapeeth provides modern labs, a central library, high-speed Wi-Fi, a sports complex, a canteen, auditorium, and dedicated research centers for AI and IoT.
Does Bharati Vidyapeeth have a placement: Yes, Bharati Vidyapeeth has an active Training & Placement Cell. Top recruiters include TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Accenture, Capgemini, and several product-based startups. Average packages range from 4–8 LPA.
What is the fee structure?: Tuition fees vary by program and category. For the most accurate and updated fee structure, please visit the official Bharati Vidyapeeth website or contact the admissions office directly.
Does the college offer hostel facilities: Bharati Vidyapeeth assists students with hostel facilities and finding nearby paying guest (PG) accommodations.
